_what_this_is: The document beside this one repaired and nothing else changed: one changed path under changelog.d/. It has to pass. What it proves is that the rule stops refusing once the entry exists, rather than refusing every package bump for ever.
title: Build the 10.11 line against 10.12.0 (#91)
body: The referenced package moves up a minor, and the entry says who it strands. For #91.
